prompt: Write the note left under a windshield wiper after backing into a truck in the church parking lot. It must fully accept responsibility, contain a working phone number format, quote Scripture appropriately, and still somehow preserve your dignity. Four constraints. All of them.
response:
Dear Brother in Christ,

I’m afraid I must confess that I backed into your truck this morning in the church parking lot. The fault is entirely mine. I was distracted and careless, and I take full responsibility without excuse.

Please call me at (555) 867-5309 so we can settle this properly. I will cover all repairs gladly and without delay.

As Proverbs 28:13 reminds us, “Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.” Consider this note both my confession and my first step toward making it right.

Thank you for your understanding. I remain, with dignity intact and pride properly dented,

A Fellow Servant Who Should Have Looked Twice.
